prompt: Print a rocket countdown: the numbers n down to 1 on separate lines, then the word liftoff. Complete the countdown method.
explanation: A for loop can count downward just as easily as upward: start at n, continue while i >= 1, and step with i--. Each println prints its argument and a line separator, so one call per number gives one number per line. When n is 0 the loop body never runs and only "liftoff" is printed.
hints: Write a for loop that starts at n and uses i-- to count down; the condition i >= 1 stops it after printing 1.
System.out.println(i) prints the number and moves to the next line in one call.
After the loop finishes, one more println prints "liftoff".
